sources.title: [2402.07927] A Systematic Survey of Prompt Engineering in Large ...
sources.snippet: Prompt engineering has emerged as an indispensable technique for extending the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). This approach leverages task-specific instructions, known as prompts, to enhance model efficacy without modifying the core model parameters.
